021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
024import org.bukkit.Location;
025import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
026
027/**
028 * TradeService
029 *
030 * @author creatorfromhell
031 * @since 6.3.0.0
032 */
033public interface TradeService {
034
035  @NotNull
036  TradeResult executeBuyFromShop(@NotNull Shop shop,
037                                 @NotNull QUser buyer,
038                                 @NotNull InventoryWrapper buyerInventory,
039                                 @NotNull Location dropLocation,
040                                 int amount);
041
042  @NotNull
043  TradeResult executeBuyFromShop(@NotNull Shop shop,
044                                 @NotNull QUser buyer,
045                                 @NotNull InventoryWrapper buyerInventory,
046                                 @NotNull Location dropLocation,
047                                 int amount,
048                                 @NotNull TradeOptions options);
049
050  @NotNull
051  TradeResult executeSellToShop(@NotNull Shop shop,
052                                @NotNull QUser seller,
053                                @NotNull InventoryWrapper sellerInventory,
054                                @NotNull Location dropLocation,
055                                int amount);
056
057  @NotNull
058  TradeResult executeSellToShop(@NotNull Shop shop,
059                                @NotNull QUser seller,
060                                @NotNull InventoryWrapper sellerInventory,
061                                @NotNull Location dropLocation,
062                                int amount,
063                                @NotNull TradeOptions options);
064
065  @NotNull
066  TradePreview previewBuyFromShop(@NotNull Shop shop,
067                                  @NotNull QUser buyer,
068                                  @NotNull InventoryWrapper buyerInventory,
069                                  int amount);
070
071  @NotNull
072  TradePreview previewSellToShop(@NotNull Shop shop,
073                                 @NotNull QUser seller,
074                                 @NotNull InventoryWrapper sellerInventory,
075                                 int amount);
076}
